title: The Kōsuke Kindaichi Series 2: The Mummy Bride
original_title: 金田一耕助シリーズ「ミイラの花嫁」
overview: The second standalone TV drama in the Kōsuke Kindaichi series, starring Ikko Furuya. Fresh blood drips from the ceiling onto a bride’s gown… Kindaichi takes on the challenge of solving this mysterious case.
